items.q: It's now called Carver, after George Washington Carver.

ctx.x: I went to McKinley Junior High School. It's now called Carver, after George Washington Carver. But I was what was called the concert master in the orchestra at that time.
So, how many years -- was it all during your junior high school (inaudible)?
